name: CARLORINO
recent: 公司将于2026年11月24日召开第十六届常年股东大会，并已发布2026财年年报。董事Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee在闭门期前多次申报持股变动，并表明在闭门期内可能有交易意向。
notable: 将于2026年11月24日召开第十六届常年股东大会。
董事Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee在2026年9月至10月期间多次申报持股变动。
董事Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee表明在闭门期内可能有交易意向。
risks: 董事Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee在闭门期内可能有交易，涉及持股变动。
公司尚未公布2026年9月30日止季度的业绩。

recent_en: Director Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee has filed multiple notifications of changes in his shareholdings and indicated an intention to deal during the closed period.
notable_en: The 16th Annual General Meeting will be held on 24 November 2026.
Director Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee filed multiple notifications of changes in shareholdings between September and October 2026.
Director Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee indicated an intention to deal during the closed period.
risks_en: Director Dato' Sri Chiang Fong Yee may trade during the closed period, involving changes in shareholdings.
The company has not yet announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
